# Open Incomes

The link you followed is intended to open a specific screen in Incomes.

If Incomes is already installed, return to the original link and open it on
your iPhone or iPad. Otherwise, download Incomes from the App Store to continue.

[Download Incomes on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1584472982)
